text: Khaplu Polo Ground Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Khaplu Polo Ground Type: Monument - Building Province: Gilgit-Baltistan District: Ghanche Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 19th Century CE Description: This historic polo ground was constructed in 1890 (1307 A.H.) by Raja Ali Sher Khan, and is situated on the southern side of the town of Khaplu, 200 m away from the famous Khaplu Fort Palace. An older polo ground is located close to the Hachi settlement which was used for cultural activities until 1972, after which community then started using this newer polo ground.
